name: com.sharq-it.sus.core
description: Vue.js-like reactive UI framework for Unity UI Toolkit: .sharq compiler (AssetPostprocessor), reactivity (Prop<T>, Computed<T>, ReactiveEffect), directives (v-if, v-show, v-for with typed item access, slot, @event), component composition (SetChildProp/BindChildProp — case-insensitive, Prop<T>-safe mutation), SusBootstrap, SusBreakpointService, SusThemeService, SusIconRegistry, OverlayHost.

samples.description: Component composition: SetChildProp and BindChildProp РІР‚вЂќ literal and reactive props between components, mutating .Value without replacing Prop<T>.

Showcase of the full design-token system: themes (Dark/Light via T key), colors, fonts, sizes, reactive breakpoints, and SusIcon icons РІР‚вЂќ all via var(--sus-*). Includes a ready ThemeShowcase.unity scene.
SusKeepAlive example: element wrapper with hide/show toggle via display:none (DOM is preserved).
